categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to clear pending bytes before writing and require explicit flushing, preventing exceptions inside destructors.
categories.rationale: Fixes a crash regression in `BufferedWriter` where write failures during destruction invoke `std::terminate` instead of normal error handling. The fix ensures the serialization stream primitive safely supports unwinding without throwing in destructors.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` by explicitly flushing buffered block and undo data writers to catch write exceptions and trigger clean fatal shutdowns.
categories.rationale: Prevents unclean node termination when writing blocks or undo data fails on full disks. Handling write errors cleanly in `blockstorage.cpp` improves crash safety and prevents abrupt `std::terminate` crashes during block storage operations.
